# Module 1 — Java introduction

Allowed: one public class, `main`, variables, primitive types, `String`, operators, `Scanner`, `System.out`, `System.err`, and comments.

Do not suggest or require: `if`, `else`, `switch`, loops, arrays, `enum`, extra classes, `private` fields, getters, setters, constructors as a design, inheritance, interfaces, abstract classes, nested classes, collections, regular expressions, exceptions, `try`, `catch`, `throw`, lambda expressions, `Optional`, the Date-Time API, the Stream API, threads, files, or web APIs.

Do not ask to validate input or handle `Scanner` errors. Review only whether the first program does what the task asks.
